questions.question: On a flat store, a key can be a file and a prefix at once. How should the model treat that?

options.label: Own outcome FileAndPrefix (Recommended)
options.description: A first-class flat outcome with its own row; each op family states it explicitly (read: the file; list: the prefix; is_folder: True). Matches today's behaviour and makes the 'file ranks first' rule visible.

options.label: Forbid it in the model
options.description: Treat shadowing as an invalid store state, outside the contract. Simplest model, but S3-like stores produce it and today's spec defines answers for it.

options.label: Opt-in, both directions (Recommended)
options.description: Extend the existing store policy so that, when on, it refuses both writing under a file and writing a file over a non-empty prefix. Default stays off: no new request on default writes, no breaking change. FileAndPrefix stays a defined outcome either way (D4).
